## Docsy
A hosted OAuth 2.1 MCP service that resolves exact framework and SDK versions, searches focused official developer documentation, and returns original source citations. Five tools are read-only. Users sign in when connecting to https://docsy.remcp.site/mcp/registry.

Installation: `claude mcp add --transport http docsy https://docsy.remcp.site/mcp/registry`.

[Setup and integrations](https://github.com/getremcp/docsy-plugin/blob/main/docs/GETTING-STARTED.md).
